description: This file contains Perl test scripts for the Coocook schema, testing database interactions, connection handling, foreign key checks, and result set behaviors using Test2::V0 and DBIx::Class.

methods.name: TestDB->new
methods.description: Creates a new test database instance.

methods.name: Coocook::Schema->connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection with various configurations.

methods.name: $db->count
methods.description: Returns the count of records in the database.

methods.name: $db->resultset
methods.description: Retrieves a result set for a specified table.

methods.name: $rs->first
methods.description: Fetches the first record in the result set.

methods.name: $rs->one_row
methods.description: Retrieves a single row from the result set.

methods.name: $db->statistics
methods.description: Returns statistics about the database schema.

methods.name: $db->sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets SQLite PRAGMA settings.

methods.name: $db->fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Runs a code block with foreign key checks disabled.

methods.name: $db->resultset('ShopSection')->new_result
methods.description: Creates a new result object for ShopSection.

methods.name: $row->insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: $row->delete
methods.description: Deletes a record from the database.

methods.name: $db->fk_checks_off_guard
methods.description: Provides a guard object to temporarily disable foreign key checks.

methods.name: $projects->assert_no_sth
methods.description: Asserts that the statement handle is not active.
